videos.title: Roblox Game Passes Are Getting FREE Trials! 🎟️ #roblox #shorts
videos.description:
Roblox announced free trials for game passes. Starting December 2, players can try an opted-in pass for one game session before buying it, with one trial per pass. Creators choose which passes get a trial and can opt in now.

videos.title: Roblox News Today: Free Pass Trials, Avatar Moments & 5 New Codes 🚨 #roblox

Plus 3 games have 5 new codes.
